tenableSc.dialog.added: Connector added. The first sync starts within a few minutes.
tenableSc.dialog.coverageHint: Scan the inventory in license-sized batches through this connector.
tenableSc.dialog.description: The Tenable.sc connector runs as its own container next to your Tenable.sc, paired like a sensor. It pulls from Tenable.sc and launches its scans; the Tenable.sc API keys stay in its config, and OpenCTEM never stores them.
tenableSc.dialog.installDocs: Config keys, the least-privilege Tenable.sc user and image verification: github.com/openctemio/connector-tenable.
tenableSc.dialog.installHint: Add a sensor in Settings > Sensors with the scanner-connector profile to get a pairing code, write the connector config (instances, allow-lists, key file paths), then run:
tenableSc.dialog.installTitle: No connector yet? Run it next to Tenable.sc
tenableSc.dialog.instanceHint: The name of the Tenable.sc instance in the connector config ("default" for the environment-variable setup).
tenableSc.dialog.name: Name
tenableSc.dialog.noSensor: No active sensor of your own
tenableSc.dialog.notConnectorHint: This sensor does not report the Tenable.sc connector. Pick the sensor of the connector image; syncs are refused until it reports the connector.
tenableSc.dialog.ownerLimits: What the connector may read and which policies and repositories scans may use are set by the connector's owner in its config; OpenCTEM can only ask within them.
tenableSc.dialog.title: Connect Tenable.sc
